protocol: Operational training flight in an F-35C. The case report gives a cabin pressure altitude of 26,000 ft after depressurization. After a two-minute descent the aircraft reached 16,000 ft and the cabin repressurized to an equivalent altitude of 8,000 ft. Exact pressure trace, starting cabin altitude and delivered gas are unavailable.
outcome_window: The pilot presented after hours following the flight. The authors report symptom resolution at the end of hyperbaric treatment and return to flying status following two weeks in non-flying status. Exact onset, presentation and treatment intervals, and post-return clinical follow-up are unavailable.
locator: September 2026 meeting abstract 188, printed p. 745 (PDF p. 85), Case Report
note: One treated case described in the meeting abstract, with no case subtype or separate diagnostic adjudication stated. The meeting program and September journal abstract report the same episode.
